scope: Evidence-quality repair in the native funnel report consumed by research bundles; not a trading-policy relaxation, new run or profitable-strategy acceptance.

original_current_run.qualification: Counters and event types are different grains, not an offered-demand census or a common exclusive funnel. Missing age includes denied Birdeye creation access and locally budget-limited RPC attempts; this does not establish billed quota exhaustion. A non-enforced missing model is not an established veto cause. No size-in-fill, win rate or net financial return can be observed without trades.

established_defects: The original native report omitted missing_age, snapshot_unavailable and current green-signal blockers from its fixed blocker vocabulary.
Missing outcomes were converted to zero returns/peaks; zero could be replaced by a more optimistic alias; booleans and infinity were accepted as measurements.
Targets, realized position fields and ending returns could masquerade as shadow outcomes or independently observed peaks.
would_pass_if_relaxed was simply the number of matching rows, without evaluating any remaining gate, route, depth, capital admission, exit or cost.

A large historical shadow peak could recommend micro_probe or allow_small_paper without a checked full-strategy counterfactual. Substring matching admitted unrelated reason labels, and missing identities were counted as tokens.
repair: Native report schema2 preserves nullable finite explicit shadow outcome measurements and true zero/sign/extreme tails. Ending return does not manufacture peak. It separates rows from distinct identified tokens, matches reason vocabulary by complete terms, includes actual observation/signal blockers and publishes recognized versus unrecognized runtime-block coverage. Counterfactual eligibility stays unknown; financial_evidence remains false. Recommendations request counterfactual evaluation rather than unsupported trading/policy relaxation; known safety blocks remain blocked. The report remains a labeled historical diagnostic, not current-run or offered-demand evidence by default.

native_original_current_comparison.input: Exact original current-run events in an isolated private root
native_original_current_comparison.interpretation: Vocabulary coverage, not causal explanation, accuracy, full eligibility or profitability.

original_validation_incidents_retained: The first isolated native probe used the stage parent instead of the frozen input root and correctly failed its139-token assertion; the root was corrected, not the assertion.
The publishing checkout has no local .venv; its first test launcher did not start pytest. The verified working runtime was then used with publishing cwd and all105 passed.

Inline rendering was first attempted while the notebook handle was still running, yielding missing-input errors; the same notebook handle completed and rendering was retried only after inputs existed.
The dependency locator had no registered handler; existing installed Node was used. Native inline rendering verified the shipped runtime without installing packages.
